_NOTE_secrets: Do NOT commit config.json. Prefer HL_GEMINI_API_KEY, HL_PEXELS_API_KEY, HL_PIXABAY_API_KEY, and HL_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL environment variables. Never share secret values.
_NOTE_rollout: Keep rollout_enabled false until all six unpublished Orus pilots pass human review. A slot may be skipped rather than filled with weak narration or footage.
_NOTE_tts: Gemini TTS with the fixed Orus identity only. Only the exact narration is sent to Gemini; no style prompt is sent, and the delivery direction is review metadata only. There is no alternate voice or time-stretch fallback.
_NOTE_footage: Exactly five distinct stock clips, sampled-frame reviewed and mapped to the five story beats. Each crop and source start is reviewed; no clip reuse or weak-gap filling.
_NOTE_music: Editorial music is opt-in. Quiet, clear narration and natural footage are the default.
_NOTE_publish_slots: Publish cadence is secondary to editorial quality. Keep rollout disabled until the unpublished pilot batch has been reviewed.
